title: Factory release-manifest
description: Immutable release manifest emitted by the factory:image job on main and consumed by release-qualification, staging, and production. The image reference must be a digest reference; human-friendly tags are never deployment inputs.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Only 1 is accepted.

project_id.description: GitLab project ID of the enrolled application.

commit_sha.description: 40-character lowercase commit SHA of the built application.

pipeline_id.description: GitLab pipeline ID that produced this release manifest.

image.description: OCI image reference with a @sha256: digest. All consumers require a digest reference; tags are never deployment inputs.

built_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when the image was built.

ci_template_sha.description: 40-character commit SHA of the ci-templates project used to build this image. This is the immutable template ref from the application's .gitlab-ci.yml include.
